identity_assessment: Synthetic run/event IDs, random event UUIDs and sentinel UUIDs, Android process/boot/nonce identifiers, source/APK/certificate hashes and emulator serial are laboratory/provenance identifiers; no personal user identity is present. Independently recomputed payload contract and sentinel contents support this classification.
limitations: Pattern scanning alone cannot prove absence of all personal data; this assessment also relies on the exact synthetic schema, source review and raw payload/state recomputation.
The review covers the extracted108-file public bundle, not private job environment, raw diagnostic logs or cloud data.
Fake token values are already redacted; the scan does not recover or expose any original credential.
